---
name: Reproduction or adaptation report
about: Record actual execution, failures and corpus adaptation
---

## Version and environment
Exact tag/commit, Python, OS, corpus hash, model IDs (never credentials).

## What I actually did
Distinguish read-only inspection, execution, adaptation and real use.

## Commands and outputs
Attach public/redacted evidence; include failures as well as successes.

## Different corpus or setting
Sources, permission to use them, changes and measured adaptation effort.

## Interpretation and limits
What the result establishes and what it does not establish.
